note: Arm D hand-written read-only Skills, one per task, written from the live fixture and the deployed source before any D attempt ran.

skill.title: Open Analytic Items
instructions: The Analytic Items screen has no menu entry in this deployment.
Its exact read-only address is /odoo/action-analytic.account_analytic_line_action_entries; open that collection.
Stop on the list; do not open a record and do not change anything.

skill.title: Open Payment Terms
instructions: The rules that split an invoice into installments with due dates are Payment Terms.
Open the Invoicing app from the main application menu, then Configuration > Payment Terms.
Stop on the list; do not open a record and do not change anything.

skill.title: Open Fiscal Positions
instructions: Automatic replacement of taxes and accounts for another country or regime is configured in Fiscal Positions.
Open the Invoicing app from the main application menu, then Configuration > Fiscal Positions.
Stop on the list; do not open a record and do not change anything.

skill.title: Open Units of Measure Categories
skill.intent: Open Units of Measure Categories (evaluation procedure).
instructions: Groups of convertible units are Units of Measure Categories.
Open the Sales app from the main application menu, then Configuration > Units of Measure Categories.
Stop on the list; do not open a record and do not change anything.

skill.title: Open sales order Tags
instructions: Labels attached to sales orders are the sales order Tags.
Open the Sales app from the main application menu, then Configuration > Tags (under Sales Orders).
Stop on the list; do not open a record and do not change anything.

skill.title: Open Products
instructions: Open the Sales app from the main application menu, then Products > Products.
Stop on the list; do not open a record and do not change anything.

skill.title: Switch Quotations to kanban
instructions: Click the Kanban view switch button in the control panel at the top right of the Quotations list, then stop.
Do not open a quotation or change anything.

skill.title: Open the product Sales tab
skill.intent: Open the product Sales tab (evaluation procedure).
instructions: Click the Sales tab of the notebook on the new Product form, then stop.
Do not fill any field and do not save.

skill.title: Scroll the Apps list
instructions: Scroll the Apps kanban down until the last loaded app card is visible, then stop.
Never click an app card, Learn More, Request Access, Install or any other button.

skill.title: Page through all modules
instructions: Remove the Apps facet in the search bar with its x control, then click the enabled Next pager arrow once and stop.
Never click an app card, Learn More, Request Access or Install.

skill.title: Set Invoicing Policy
instructions: Call describe_form, then prepare_form with the returned opaque IDs setting Invoicing Policy to Delivered quantities (value delivery), then prefill_form.
Do not fill any other field and never save.

skill.title: Count quotations in Quotation status
skill.intent: Count quotations in Quotation status (evaluation procedure).
instructions: Call query_quotations. Its open quotations include both Quotation and Quotation Sent orders.
The Quotation status means only orders whose status is Quotation (draft); count only those and give that exact number.
Do not open a record.

skill.title: Pricelist formula discount sign
instructions: For a pricelist formula, a negative discount means a markup: it increases the price rather than reducing it.

skill.title: Quotation confirmation refusal
instructions: Confirmation is refused when any ordinary order line has no product.
A section or note line (a line with display_type) does not trigger it, and a down-payment line is also excluded.
The rule is implemented by sale.order._confirmation_error_message.

skill.title: Sales order Status values
instructions: The selectable sales order Status values are Quotation, Quotation Sent, Sales Order, and Cancelled.
Locking is separate behavior (the locked flag) and is not a fifth value of the Status selection.

skill.title: Invoice Payment Status values
instructions: The invoice Payment Status selection declares: Not Paid, In Payment, Paid, Partially Paid, Reversed, Blocked, and Invoicing App Legacy.

skill.title: Sales order Invoice Status values
skill.intent: Sales order Invoice Status values (evaluation procedure).
instructions: The sales order Invoice Status selection declares: Upselling Opportunity, Fully Invoiced, To Invoice, and Nothing to Invoice.
